notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]1: Teleportation completely removed from the game
2: Smooth free Movement added
3: Some object not saving issue resolved
4: The inventory system is bug-free now
5: Optimized Graphics
6: Quest 2 Support - Fully tested with Oculus Air Link[/b]

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
Update/improve translations for all languages.
New Ghosts and Horror scenes in most of the levels
Highly optimized graphics for low-end devices
Ability to change movement from teleports to locomotion.
Oculus 2 support for AIRPLAY
Bugs fixes in losing an item after save.
Other major Bug fixes, stability improvements, etc.


If all testing goes well, we plan to release all of this by 25th Sep 2021

Thank you for all the positive feedback and Negative feedbacks. 
Sorry for any trouble you faced while playing this game, This update will cover everything.

Feel free to write feedback and suggestions. Thank you for being with us.
